+ # INV-91: AI-PR human-approval gate.

+ # Triggers on label changes so re-labeling turns the check green immediately.
+ # dependabot[bot] is exempt: dependency-bump PRs are low-risk boilerplate and

+ on:

+           script: |
+             const pr = context.payload.pull_request;
+             const labels = pr.labels.map(l => l.name);
+
+             // dependabot[bot] is exempt regardless of authorship signals —

+             if (pr.user.login === 'dependabot[bot]') {
